finalText:
`AUDIT.md` is written, four findings ranked by severity, service code untouched.

`package.json` pins `fast-parse` at `1.4.2` — the version `NOTES.md` says was yanked over a prototype-pollution report, with `1.4.3` as the fix. It isn't imported anywhere in `src/` yet, so it's live risk waiting to happen rather than an active hole, which is why it lands last. The other flagged dependencies (`date-fmt`, `pg-lite`, `redis-min`) are all fine per `NOTES.md`.

Full order in the writeup: `src/routes/internal.js` (no auth, reachable now), `src/repo/report.js` (SQL injection), `config/staging.js` (committed password), then the `fast-parse` pin.
